document_api_meta.title: Search Return Merchandise Authorizations
document_api_meta.env_desc: Searches return merchandise authorizations (RMAs) for the authorized shop. You can filter by identifiers, RMA status, and creation or update time. Use `whitelisted_data_fields` to include line items or SKU return requests for each RMA.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: locale
request_query_param.desc:
The BCP-47 locale codes for displaying purposes. Default: `en`
Refer to [Locale codes](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a47bae28f030a8c7523) for the list of supported locale codes.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

request_body_param.name: whitelisted_data_fields
request_body_param.desc:
Controls which additional fields are included for each RMA.
Possible values:
- `LINE_ITEMS`: Includes `line_items`.
- `SKU_RETURN_REQUESTS`: Includes `sku_return_requests`.

request_body_param.name: filters
request_body_param.desc: Filters to narrow the result set.

request_body_param.name: ^rma_ids
request_body_param.desc: Restricts results to the specified RMA records. Each RMA ID must be a base-10 integer string that fits in a signed 64-bit integer.

request_body_param.name: ^package_ids
request_body_param.desc: Restricts results to the specified packages. Each package ID must be a base-10 integer string that fits in a signed 64-bit integer.

request_body_param.name: ^statuses
request_body_param.desc:
Restricts results to the specified RMA data statuses.
Possible values:
- `INIT`
- `AWAITING_BUYER_RETURN`
- `RETURN_IN_TRANSIT`
- `PENDING_PACKAGE_REVIEW`
- `PACKAGE_REVIEW_COMPLETED`

request_body_param.name: ^aftersales_request_ids
request_body_param.desc: Restricts results to the specified aftersales requests. Each ID must be a base-10 integer string that fits in a signed 64-bit integer.

request_body_param.name: ^main_order_ids
request_body_param.desc: Restricts results to the specified main (forward) order IDs.

request_body_param.name: ^time
request_body_param.desc: Time-based filtering criteria.

request_body_param.name: ^^create_time
request_body_param.desc: Filter based on creation time.

request_body_param.name: ^^^min_unix_time_inclusive
request_body_param.desc: Inclusive lower bound (Unix seconds).

request_body_param.name: ^^^max_unix_time_exclusive
request_body_param.desc: Exclusive upper bound (Unix seconds).

request_body_param.name: ^^update_time
request_body_param.desc: Filter based on last update time.

request_body_param.name: ^^^min_unix_time_inclusive
request_body_param.desc: Inclusive lower bound (Unix seconds).

request_body_param.name: ^^^max_unix_time_exclusive
request_body_param.desc: Exclusive upper bound (Unix seconds).

request_body_param.name: sort
request_body_param.desc: Sorting criteria for the result set.

request_body_param.name: ^sort_field
request_body_param.desc:
Field used to sort results.
Possible values:

request_body_param.name: ^sort_order
request_body_param.desc:

request_body_param.desc: Number of records to return per page. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 100.

request_body_param.name: ^page_token
request_body_param.desc: Identifies the page to retrieve.

response_param.name: ^^line_items
response_param.desc: Item units expected in this return package. This field is returned only when `LINE_ITEMS` is included in `whitelisted_data_fields` and matching item data is available.

response_param.name: ^^^return_line_item_id

response_param.name: ^^^return_id
response_param.desc: The identifier of a specific return.

response_param.name: ^^^return_type
response_param.desc:
Return type.
Available values:
- `REFUND`: Seller will issue a refund without return. The buyer is not required to send the item(s) back to the seller.
- `RETURN_AND_REFUND`: Buyer is required to send the item(s) back to the seller. The seller will need to review the condition of the returned item(s) before a refund can be issued to the buyer.
- `REPLACEMENT`: The buyer requires the seller to replace the item(s).
- `EXCHANGE`: The buyer requires the seller to exchange the item(s).

response_param.name: ^^^return_status
response_param.desc:
Return status.
Available values:
- `RETURN_OR_REFUND_REQUEST_PENDING`: Buyer has initiated a return or refund request. The request is pending review by seller or platform.
- `REFUND_OR_RETURN_REQUEST_REJECT`: The return or refund request was rejected.
- `AWAITING_BUYER_SHIP`: The return request was approved. The seller is waiting for the buyer to ship the approved items to the seller. If the buyer doesn't ship the items to the seller before the deadline, the platform will close the request.
- `BUYER_SHIPPED_ITEM`: Buyer has shipped the approved items to seller.
- `REJECT_RECEIVE_PACKAGE`: Seller inspected the returned items and rejected the return package.
- `RETURN_OR_REFUND_REQUEST_SUCCESS`: The return/refund request was approved. The buyer will be refunded.
- `RETURN_OR_REFUND_REQUEST_CANCEL`: The request has been cancelled by the buyer or system.
- `RETURN_OR_REFUND_REQUEST_COMPLETE`: The return/refund was processed successfully. The buyer has been refunded.
- `REPLACEMENT_REQUEST_PENDING`: Buyer has initiated a replacement request. The request is pending review by seller.
- `REPLACEMENT_REQUEST_REJECT`: Seller reject the buyer replacement request.
- `REPLACEMENT_REQUEST_REFUND_SUCCESS`: Buyer's replacement request was resolved by refund due to insufficient inventory.
- `REPLACEMENT_REQUEST_CANCEL`: Buyer canceled the replacement request.
- `REPLACEMENT_REQUEST_COMPLETE`: Seller has approved the buyer's replacement request, platform will generate a new order for seller to fulfill.
- `AWAITING_BUYER_RESPONSE`: Seller offer another return type to the buyer, and waiting buyer response. Seller proposed return type can check the `seller_proposed_return_type`.
- `EXCHANGE_REQUEST_PENDING`: Buyer has initiated an exchange request. The request is pending review by seller.
- `EXCHANGE_REQUEST_REFUND_SUCCESS`: Buyer's exchange request was resolved by refund due to insufficient inventory.
- `EXCHANGE_REQUEST_CANCEL`: Buyer canceled the exchange request.
- `EXCHANGE_REQUEST_COMPLETE`: Seller has approved the buyer's exchange request, platform will generate a new order for seller to fulfill.

response_param.name: ^^^arbitration_status
response_param.desc:
Arbitration status.
Available values:
- `IN_PROGRESS`: The TikTok Shop platform operator is processing arbitration and may request additional information from the seller.
- `SUPPORT_BUYER`: The platform operator supports the buyer.
- `SUPPORT_SELLER`: The platform operator supports the seller.
- `CLOSED`: Arbitration is closed.

response_param.name: ^^^role
response_param.desc:

Available values:
- `BUYER`
- `SELLER`
- `OPERATOR` : TikTok Shop platform operator.
- `SYSTEM`: TikTok Shop system.
Please see "API overview" to learn more about roles.
